name: Metropolitan underground passenger railway
description: London’s Metropolitan Railway operated steam-hauled underground passenger service between Paddington and Farringdon Street.

impact.note: First underground urban railway, a new way to move through cities later copied in many countries; successors are improved metros.

date.basis: The cited source dates this scoped episode.

events.statement: The Metropolitan Railway opened its Paddington–Farringdon Street underground line to the public.
events.caveats: Passenger count is a retrospective museum estimate without its primary accounting record in the passage.

evidence.supports: Museum gives the public opening date, route and day-one passenger count.
Museum identifies steam-powered underground passenger service on the same opening date.
